# When should safe fall control take over normal WBC?

> **Current answer:** The structure described in this post uses a lightweight predictor to determine if a fall is unrecoverable, followed by a dedicated RL strategy, rather than continuous interference in normal control. The warnings and damage reduction numbers listed in the post have not been independently verified and cannot be directly used as threshold values; verification of false positives, false negatives, and takeover delay is required.
